mapper.select: SELECT id, department1, department2, department3, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM org_chart ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_chart (department1, department2, department3, sort_order) VALUES (#{department1}, #{department2}, #{department3}, #{sortOrder})

INSERT INTO employees (employee_id, name, department1, department2, department3, rank, email, status) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{name}, #{department1}, #{department2}, #{department3}, #{rank}, #{email}, '재직')
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET status = #{status} WHERE employee_id = #{id}
UPDATE employees SET status = '퇴사' WHERE employee_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_history (employee_id, action_type, change_date) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{actionType}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM employee_history WHERE employee_id = #{id} ORDER BY change_date DESC
SELECT * FROM assets ORDER BY accounting_ledger, accounting_ledger_index, asset_id
SELECT * FROM assets WHERE status = '재고' ORDER BY asset_id
SELECT * FROM assets WHERE current_user_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY asset_id
SELECT * FROM assets WHERE current_user_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE assets SET current_user_id = NULL, status = '재고' WHERE current_user_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assets (asset_id, category, model, serial_number, accounting_ledger, accounting_ledger_index, status, current_user_id, reason, purchase_date, residual_value) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{category}, #{model}, #{serialNumber}, #{accountingLedger}, #{accountingLedgerIndex}, '재고', NULL, #{reason}, #{purchaseDate}, #{residualValue})
mapper.update: UPDATE assets SET category = #{category}, model = #{model}, serial_number = #{serialNumber}, accounting_ledger = #{accountingLedger}, accounting_ledger_index = #{accountingLedgerIndex}, reason = #{reason}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, residual_value = #{residualValue}, status = #{status} WHERE asset_id = #{assetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_history (asset_id, employee_id, prev_user_id, action_type, status, reason, change_date) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{employeeId}, #{prevUserId}, #{actionType}, #{status}, #{reason}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE asset_history SET employee_id = NULL, prev_user_id = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM asset_history WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY change_date DESC
SELECT * FROM asset_history ORDER BY change_date DESC
SELECT * FROM asset_history WHERE history_id = CAST(#{historyId} AS INTEGER)
SELECT * FROM asset_history WHERE prev_user_id = #{employeeId} AND action_type = '교체(반납)' ORDER BY change_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.email FROM asset_history h LEFT JOIN employees e ON (h.employee_id = e.employee_id OR h.prev_user_id = e.employee_id) WHERE h.history_id = CAST(#{historyId} AS INTEGER) AND e.email IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
